_notes: Telegram bridge (ticket 0043), NON-SECRET settings only. The token + your Telegram user id live in py/tg_connection.json (git-ignored) or the env. notify_patterns: a new bus post is pushed to Telegram if its text contains any of these (case-insensitive) -- keep it to genuinely notable events so the phone doesn't buzz on every post. bus_check_interval_sec: how often outbound bus events are checked. poll_timeout_sec: Telegram long-poll timeout for inbound. commands_enabled: the read-only command set; safety ops are deliberately not here yet.
